name: Falls Church city, VA
findings: Falls Church city has 135 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Falls Church city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Falls Church city list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
